source: Locally extracted UE5.6 Minecraft Dungeons II assets
exact: Soul Storm mask and rarity marker source texture bytes
Enchantment/effect distinction from M_EnchantIndicator and MI_EffectIndicator

equipment.mask: Native T_UI_SlotRarity_Markers_Soul: blue channel for the three weapon/armor souls; green channel for the five artifact souls. Native PNG bytes and per-glyph opacity retained.
equipment.frame: Screenshot-matched red/blue frame: 2% outer stroke, 1% inner stroke and 8% corner caps, fading toward the lower-right corner; no gray inventory equipment-slot border
equipment.removed: Inventory equipment-slot gray outer frame, whole-slot crack masks and orange tint
equipment.image_box_to_frame_ratio: 243/306 (79.4118%); opaque native sprite template matching against the supplied 1474 x 368 screenshot; original alpha padding retained
equipment.soul_marker_cell: 88/306 (28.7582%) full packed texture viewport; blue channel retains three souls, green channel retains five
equipment.soul_marker_position: 31/306 (10.1307%) from top and left; original 20 x 20 texture padding retained, without centering a cropped glyph group

book.icon_to_book_ratio: Native icon texture box 158/159 (99.37%) of the full book texture box, clipped inside a 62.5% diamond viewport
book.reference: User supplied 3840 x 2160 enchantment collection screenshot; measurements normalized to 2048 x 1152
book.icon_position: 50% horizontally and 45.3125% vertically, matching the native transparent opening; original book texture renders above the icon

level_indicator.rendering: Purple diamond with a dark lower edge, Roman level centered
level_indicator.face_ratio: Square diamond face, 62 px wide; 4 px lower edge in the normalized screenshot; total height 66/62 of width
level_indicator.position: Roman numeral centered on the face; badge vertically centered beside each effect paragraph; text gap 12/62 of badge width
level_indicator.web_sizes: 30 px wide for enchantments and 22 px for possible effects; identical proportional geometry

limitations: Frame and level badge geometry are browser implementations matched against supplied screenshots, not an extracted shader render.
Unique red matches the supplied running game; the earlier static default color token was orange and is not used for this reference.
No game equipment power, favorite or equipped state is invented on the drop catalogue.
visual_reference: User supplied 1474 x 368 four-item game screenshot, 2026-10-10; measurements recorded in inventory-reference-measurements.json
